description: Portal-token HR submissions had blank submitter_name/submitter_email in the persisted row because leadership/HR/PM users don't retype their identity in the request body. Legacy corpus: 28/59 rows with no submitter_name · 44/44 new_hire rows with no payload.company (intentional for new_hire pre-approval).
fix: Portal-token submitters now inherit submitter_name from _actor_label(actor) and submitter_email from actor.email when the body doesn't provide them. Anonymous submissions are NEVER given a fabricated identity — they remain intentionally classified as requested_by_role='anonymous'.

description: `POST /api/employee-requests` had no idempotency protection. Concurrent same-key retries could create duplicate HR requests · duplicate HR notifications · duplicate Trust Spine lifecycle emissions.
fix: Wrapped submit_request body in `_do_create` closure and called `with_idempotency(db · key · actor or public · _do_create · workflow=\"hr_request\")` at the end.

description: HR portal guard had no PVI validation fallback — HR PVI tokens could not be used to test HR-scoped workflows in preview.
fix: Added try_validation_fallback(db · token · expected_role='hr') after real HR auth fails · same doctrine as safety_portal/_deps and shop_portal_deps.

description: Legacy HR/Admin gate used by the employee-requests router had no PVI fallback — HR PVI could not exercise the list/approve/reject endpoints in preview.
fix: Added PVI fallback (role=hr) after real HR/admin auth fails. Admin PVI intentionally NOT accepted (admin identity is a real credential).

description: The multi-portal aggregator (used by dozens of routes) had no PVI fallback — HR PVI presented via X-HR-Token was invisible to any route using this aggregator.
fix: Added PVI fallback loop across safety · hr · shop · pm · dispatch · fl tokens after every real auth attempt fails. Admin PVI intentionally NOT accepted.

description: Pre-existing latent bug — _require_optional_portal_token called _require_any_portal_token without the newly-required `request` positional argument (added upstream in an earlier iter but never propagated here). Would have caused 500s on any employee-requests submit reaching a portal-token code path.
fix: Added `request: Request` to _require_optional_portal_token signature and passed through to _require_any_portal_token.
